title: ai.qory.run.started
description: The runtime is about to start. The first event of a run in the file, and the event a receiver creates the run on.

runtime_version.description: The runtime version the runner's adapter for it, a descriptor say, was written against; not the version installed, which the runner does not know. Absent for a runtime the runner runs and does not read.

command.description: The program started, as given to the runner.

args.description: Its arguments, as given. Environment is never reported.

dir.description: The working directory the runtime starts in.

interactive.description: True when the session runs on a pseudo-terminal, false on pipes.

wall.description: The adapter that built the enclosure the runtime runs in: docker. Absent when there is no wall, where command and dir are the machine's own; present, they are the enclosure's.

image.description: The image the enclosure runs, as the run named it. Present with wall.

labels.description: The caller's own names for the run, its key in a queue, a repository, an issue, as the command that started the run was given them. The runner copies them and reads nothing into them. Only this event carries them; a receiver keeps them with the run it creates on it.
